note: Part I title «السجلّ»; «سجلّ مَن رفضوا». Because «سجلّ» is taken, Deleuze and Guattari's «register» in ch. 1 is «مستوى».
A production line: «خط إنتاج للأهداف», «خط إنتاج الاختطاف والنقل القسري». Kept apart from «سلسلة القتل» (kill chain).
Deleuze and Guattari's assujettissement / asservissement machinique; «subject» is «ذات». Needs a check against the Arabic translation of A Thousand Plateaus (ألف هضبة).
Plural «قوائم القتل». «قائمة اغتيالات» was the alternative; the English says kill, not assassination.

en: peer (Milgram's defying peers; the defiant peer)

note: «تشكيل» is formation and «ترتيب» reads as tidying, so «تأليف» (composing, as music or a text is composed). Needs a native check.

Plain register: the word an adult says out loud, neither clinical nor crude. Don't make it polite. A term of labor satire, never set beside the kill chain (D-810). MSA is formal by nature, so the term sits on the clinical rung; the casual and crude words belong to the spoken dialects. The scene: «التبوّل في زجاجات». Needs a native check.
